bluetoothInput.note: Or turn the input selector on the front panel until the display shows BLUETOOTH.

steps: Press again until the display shows Stereo
stereoMode.note: Stereo keeps each sweep in its own speaker. Avoid All Ch Stereo, Dolby Surround or DTS Neural:X while measuring.

dynamicFeaturesOff.note: Turn off Late Night, Music Optimizer and any loudness or dynamic volume feature you see.

roomCorrectionToggle.note: Choose Off to turn Dirac Live off, or pick your saved filter to keep it on.

testTone.note: Moving to a speaker in this list plays the receiver's test tone through it.

crossover.note: Set your main speakers to a frequency (not Full Band) so deep bass goes to the subwoofer.

manualEQ.note: Manual EQ is only available while Dirac Live is off.

subwooferPhase.note: Most subwoofers have the phase control on their own back panel.

notes: Unverified profile built from Onkyo's published conventions. Menu names, ranges and EQ bands must be confirmed on a real TX-RZ50 (v1.1).
EQ bands and ±6 dB / 1 dB steps follow earlier Onkyo manual-EQ layouts.
